title: Dynamics 365 Sales: copy a Sales Development agent's configuration to another agent
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, preview procedure, licensing prerequisites and consumption billing are supported. The Graph activation reference needs one qualification: it describes a reviewed beta contract whose deployed availability depends on the matching schema and backend release.
